caption: The drawing displays three main objects and a small label against a beige background. The upper left object is a circular, black item with several gold or bronze elements, including two round features and a larger circular area filled with brownish material; it has a smooth, glossy surface. To the upper right, there is a cylindrical container with a flared middle and black top, colored in shades of brown and decorated with a gold illustration of animals and figures on its side; the top surface contains coin-shaped elements. Below these two objects is a label bordered in red with a light blue inner rectangle bearing small, dark text. The lower central object is a smaller, black, cylindrical item adorned with a gold leaf or laurel pattern on its sides and similar internal components visible from above. The objects are spaced apart, each presented with clear separation on the plain background.
title: Stencilled Inkwells
